from collections import deque, Counter
H=W=30
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(H):
 for c in range(W):
  if grid[r][c]==9 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
  while q:
   x,y=q.popleft();cells.append((x,y))
   for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
    nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
    if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and grid[nx][ny]!=9 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
     seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
  comps.append(cells)
info=[]
for cells in comps:
 rs=[r for r,c in cells];cs=[c for r,c in cells]
 box=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
 area=(box[1]-box[0]+1)*(box[3]-box[2]+1)
 colors=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in cells)
 info.append((len(cells),box,area,area-len(cells),colors))
